instruction: An oversized adjustable pipe wrench reimagined with brass gears, copper piping, and a tiny pressure gauge set into its handle. Riveted iron jaws grip an ornate valve, while an exposed clockwork mechanism drives the adjustment screw. Aged bronze and blued steel surfaces show oil stains and patina, blending industrial tool with fantastical machinery.
